data.name: Lukas Adventure 64
data.detailed_description:
From old promotional magazines

"Lukas is back in this new 3D installment! Get ready to collect gems and platform through tricky levels to stop the evil King Slime!"

History:

Lukas Adventure 64 was a game developed by the studio Low-Flux Games and published by Lukas Entertainment in 1998 but was quickly taken of store shelfs due to it's poor sales and certain versions not functioning however a update for the game was planned and stayed in the development all the way to 2001 before being cancelled. This version of the game is a port of the original version it has been slightly modified for this 2026 release but the game is mostly intact. It includes both the 1998 version and the 2001 version. 

What it actually is: 

Lukas Adventure 64 is a ARG collectathon horror game where you will have to traverse through hundreds of levels collecting Gems and solving puzzles. While playing you might encounter intentional glitches, be taken to websites or weird creatures. The game is made like a maze so it is recommended to have a pen and paper ready to draw out a map. 

Features:

  • Hundreds of Collectables, Levels and Puzzles.

  • Personalization so that each playthrough is different.

  • Complex Puzzles which can take days to solve.

  • An Interactive ARG where you will have to explore outside the game.

  • A maze like overworld where each level connects to each other.

DISCLAIMER:

Everything seen in this game is a work of fiction. Anything which resembles real life events are not intentional.

Inspired by Shipwrecked 64, Catastrophe Crow and B3313

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
